definition-changed.answer: §2002:4 (4.153) 'expected to be received by a particular subprogram' vs §2023:3.148 'a particular called program': the same PROGRAM-ID ... IS PROTOTYPE element; the source elements that admit formats 1 and 2 are unchanged.

definition-dropped.answer: §2002:4 (4.121) 'A procedural entity defined by a method definition within, or inherited by, a class definition'; 2023 drops the entry and describes methods in 9.3.4. The rule names the method definition (a source element), the same element in both; the element kinds that admit formats 1 and 2 are unchanged.

pending-clause.answer: Read §2002:9.3.5: 2002 binds a method by name only (no method resolution signature or overloading, which 2023 9.3.6 adds). The rule says which source elements may use procedure division formats 1 and 2; it does not rest on method binding. No dependence.
